o3.say: The Patriarch closes his eyes: 'The counting ended, and we remained.' The Forewoman checks her sums twice. The Regent just smiles, like a man whose deletion is finally relevant. The world overflowed, traveler. The resets are failing. That's why you remember every run — and why, this time, everything gets to MATTER.

options.label: Ready
options.text: Then let's decide what happens next.

o2.say: 'HELLO, WORLD!' That's all it says. The first artifact of existence, and it's a greeting — OUR greeting, the one the Capitol's said to every visitor since the beginning. The terminal below it is still running. One number, incrementing nowhere: RUN #2,147,483,648.

options.label: Overflow
options.text: That number... it's one past the largest count the world can hold.

o5.say: The terminal blinks, patient as scripture: AWAITING FINAL OUTPUT_ Behind you the Abyssal Lantern gutters out, its oil spent. Its work is done.

o1.say: The lantern holds. Down the shaft — your pitons would've saved an hour on those dead stairs — past pipes labeled in no alphabet, into a room that hums like the corn. A brass plaque. A terminal. And three people who got here first.
